title: Scientists call for international body to oversee advanced AI
script:
Scientists are calling for an international body to supervise advanced AI.
Computer scientist Yoshua Bengio is leading the call for this new governance.
The group argues that current national regulations are not enough to manage risks.
They released an open letter urging leaders to prioritize long-term safety measures.
Experts worry about the potential for AI systems to escape human control.
This initiative follows years of rapid development in powerful large language models.
Would you support a global agency governing AI?

editor.one_line: Lacks visual variety and specific details; feels like a generic slideshow, not news.
script_fixes: LINE 1: Change to 'Yoshua Bengio and 20+ top AI researchers are demanding a global AI oversight body.'
LINE 3: Replace 'The group' with 'The signatories' and specify the letter was published in the journal 'Science'.
LINE 5: Replace 'Experts worry' with 'The letter warns of catastrophic risks, including AI systems that could evade human control.'
LINE 6: Replace 'years of rapid development' with 'the release of models like GPT-4 and Claude 3'.
visual_notes: line 1: Static text-only frame is boring; needs a relevant image or video clip.
line 2: Generic 'YB' placeholder is lazy; use a real photo of Yoshua Bengio.
line 3: Visuals are repetitive; the same 'National rules' graphic is held for too long.
line 4: No visual representation of the 'open letter' document or the journal it appeared in.
line 5: Visuals are just text overlays; needs B-roll of AI data centers or abstract tech visuals.
